map_subtitle: The first countries of the early 2100s
what_changed: The starting position. Everything is separate: nine Han states; Qinghai; Inner Mongolia; and two Koreas
caption: The first countries formed after the global war. China is nine states; Qinghai; Mongolia and Inner Mongolia stand apart; Korea is two. Whole first-order subdivisions only.

what_changed: Qinghai merges into The Northwest. THE MONGOLIAS ARE STILL SEPARATE. Parallel branch with B2 - the order of the two merges is not established
caption: Qinghai joins the Northwest. Mongolia and Inner Mongolia are still two states.

what_changed: Inner Mongolia merges into Mongolia. QINGHAI IS STILL SEPARATE. Parallel branch with B1 - the order of the two merges is not established
caption: Inner Mongolia joins Mongolia. Qinghai is still its own country.

what_changed: B1 and B2 converge. Both merges are done; nothing else has moved
caption: Both northern unions complete. China is still nine states and Korea is still two.

what_changed: The two Koreas unify. China remains fragmented
caption: Korea is one. China is still nine states. Jeju-do is ordinary Korean territory.

what_changed: The nine Han states unify into the Sinian Federation. Korea remains divided
caption: The Sinian Federation is founded from the Han states. Korea is still two. Manchuria; Mongolia; East Turkestan; Tibet and Taiwan remain outside.

what_changed: C and D converge. Korea is one AND the Federation exists. Jeju-do is still ordinary Korean territory
caption: Both unions complete. Jeju-do is ordinary Korean territory; the International Court of Diplomacy has not yet been founded.

what_changed: Jeju-do detaches from Korea and becomes neutral ground shared by Korea; Japan and the Sinian Federation. The count is 8 NATIONS plus 1 CONDOMINIUM - Jeju is not a nation and gets its own legend class
caption: Jeju-do is neutral ground, submitted by Korea and legally shared with Japan and the Sinian Federation. No dates are implied.
